summary: Iteration 104 — Phase 1 absence regulation (faculty rule) tested across backend + admin UI. 13/13 pytest cases pass. Admin UI (/report-warnings and /general-settings) verified. Student UI (/my-attendance) not tested via browser (student web login was flaky — 403); student endpoints verified via API using 1001/test1234.
critical_code_review_comments: services/absence_engine.classify correctly uses strict `>` for the candidate decision (10% exact ≠ candidate, 10.01% = candidate). Verified by 4 edge-case engine tests.

course_profiles pre-filters lectures with status='completed' and uses credited_minutes when present — hours denominator correct. Enrollment-date check skips lectures predating enrollment only when attendance record is missing — matches spec.

GET /api/reports/warnings uses faculty-level limits per course (course_limits→faculty_limits). summary.unexcused_limit falls back to the first course's limits — if no courses are found it defaults to {10,25,4}. Minor: when caller filters by faculty but has mixed-limit courses, the summary.unexcused_limit may reflect only the first course; not a bug for current rule but worth noting.
/students/me/absence-profile sorts by severity relative to each course's own limits — good.
report-warnings UI (frontend) correctly reads summary.rule, min_executed, and renders منفَّذة/بلا عذر%/الإجمالي%/س متبقية بلا عذر; early indicator rendered; no threshold pickers remain.

success_rate.frontend: verified for admin flows (warnings + settings); student UI not browser-tested (noted flaky login)

test_credentials: admin/admin123 (OK), 1001/test1234 (student — API OK; web UI login got 403 intermittently per review-request note)
